messages.subject: Instructions to advise — Halstead Aerospace v Ferncliffe Alloys
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Rosenthal,

Please find with the papers our instructions to advise on the merits and quantum of Halstead's claim against Ferncliffe, and to settle the Particulars of Claim. The key documents are the supply agreement, the Argent report of Dr Frost, NCR QN-2024-0337 and the draft schedule of loss (£2,917,070 direct). We'd be grateful for your view on the clause 12 acceptance point and on the recoverability of the Caldera LD exposure in particular.

Kind regards,
Tom Gallagher
Whitfield Carter LLP

messages.subject: RE: Instructions to advise — Halstead Aerospace v Ferncliffe Alloys
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

My written advice follows. In short: liability strong, clause 12 not a real obstacle given latency. On quantum, realistic recoverable core £2.2-2.5m; the Caldera LDs are the most exposed to remoteness — plead but treat as negotiating margin. Two drafting points for the Particulars: (1) claim interest at 5% under s.35A, not 4%, to reflect Halstead's borrowing cost; (2) add an express averment of mitigation. I'll mark up the draft Particulars accordingly.

Catherine Rosenthal KC
Eldon Chambers
